notes.title: The BIGUPS Update
notes.content:
Its major update time, you know what that means! MAJOR BUGS WOOO.
[previewyoutube=IXb3w9JjBMw;full][/previewyoutube]
I only have windows video editor plz be nice :(

I have successfully jacked into the Matrix and made Pulseball Matrix compatible.

To play in VR mode, simply make sure your VR headset is plugged in and run the game. It should detect it automatically and switch. Only training mode is supported right now, competitive and bots coming in a week or two. This is really more of a demo than anything else, I haven't added it to the VR category yet because its so early.

Additionally, I have harnessed the power of wormholes, something scientists have struggled to do five-ever. I am using this advanced technology to add a new game mode to Pulseball instead of bettering humanity. Essentially this is a much faster paced game mode. No more "rounds", you score, the ball shoots back through the center wormhole and you keep playing. 

To try the new Blackhole game mode, either select from the main menu to play with a bot, or host a game and set the game mode to "blackhole". Unlike VR support this is further along and should work for both PVE and PVP.

Features:
[list]
[*] LIMITED VR Support 
[*] NEW GAMEMODE "Blackhole mode"
[/list]

Bugs Fixed:
[list]
[*] Enemy Sound was glitched (shout out lexFley for the heads up)
[*] Controller input less wonky
[*] Minor Netcode Improvements
[/list]

[b]VR mode was developed with an HP WMR headset, I have added inputs for other headsets and controllers but I don't have a Vive or Oculus so PLEASE let me know how it plays on other headsets[/b]. I am working on getting at least a Rift S or Quest 2 in the future. I have also requested a Vive devkit from steam, but they will 100% say no lol. 

Things on the immediate todo/upcoming update list:
[list]
[*] Add Bot + Multiplayer VR support
[*] Obtain and act on VR feedback
[*] Re-integrate Volleyball 
[/list]


As always, Discord is best for communication/feedback/insults: https://discord.gg/jPpPgSjNnn

Thanks for reading!
-Twiggs

notes.title: Bug fixes + Announcement
notes.content:
Hey Bert Gang, Lots of bug fixes since the last update, [i]since it created lots of bugs. [/i]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added change class option to the in-game menu
[/list]


Bugs:
[list]
[*] RoBert works with Classes now
[*] RoBert no longer glitches if you try to play two matches
[*] Random crashes mostly taken care of
[*] Heavy class works now
[*] SMG class no longer freezes after scoring a goal
[*] SMG class gun sound fixed
[*] Matches should start with any combination of players/classes now
[/list]
[h3]
Now for the Announcement, We sold out. [/h3]

Not really but kinda. A startup reached out to me a while ago to implement intrinsic advertising in Pulseball. This is something I planned on doing once we gained a larger player base, albeit in a more 1v1 capacity with advertisers. 

Essentially this will work the same way real sports stadiums operate, advertisements around the stadium. No popups, nothing to click on or interrupt you, they will just be [b]there.[/b] 

Currently it will more than likely generate no meaningful revenue. My plan is to eventually use it to pay for dedicated servers to cut down on lag and improve the overall player experience.  Based on my testing this should have a negligible impact on performance. 

If everyone hates this experiment, I'll remove it immediately. 

Discord: https://discord.gg/gBpUkPZABR

Thanks,
-Twiggs

notes.title: The National Annual End of the Year Pulseball Tournament Update
notes.content:
HELLO ATHLETES

The tournament will be played on a separate build of Pulseball which you can access via these instructions:

1. Go to your steam library, locate pulseball
2. Right click it and select "properties"
3. Go to "betas" and put in the code "extremespots" (no quotes)
4. Download the update and play


The main differences are the ability to change teams and longer delays in the beginning of matches which will be more suitable for the tournament. Eventually I will be implementing cleaner code/game/everything, but until that time arrives, this is what we got.

notes.title: Bug fix update 1
notes.content:
Hey all, late update guy here. 

This update isn't much of anything, various minor bug fixes + tweaks. Biggest bug was players wouldn't always be notified when someone hosted a game and needed a player.

notes.title: The KNOWLEDGE Update
notes.content:
Yeah I re-used the photo, deal with it.

Nothing too ground breaking added in this update. I setup a notification system to alert players in a game by themselves if another game is available. This is to help facilitate matchmaking + online play until it makes sense for me to implement dedicated servers.

Bert received some cosmetic updates, nothing under the hood has been changed. He just [i]looks[/i] smarter.

Features added:
-Removed auto connect for training chat, training mode will load much faster now
-Player online notifications, when playing in training mode or in a lonely lobby the game will occasionally check if any other matches are available and notify you. 
-Gave Bert [u]precisely[/u] 20 more I.Q points to look less stupid
-"Find Game" automatically starts looking for sessions, users no longer need to go through the effort of clicking another button.

notes.title: The BIG CHUNGUS update
notes.content:
Alright guys, didn't get as much in as I wanted but didn't want to wait another week. Bigger maps were added to make the 2v2 matches more enjoyable however any map can be played with more players now by changing the  "Number of players" option when hosting a game. This setting isn't capped so you can play with 10 people if you wanted, just don't be surprised if stuff doesn't work. 

Volleyball was also crudely implemented. It's still a work in progress but it should be playable now. 

Lastly, A Power-O-Meter was added to allow you to change gun power on the fly with the mouse scroll wheel. This doesn't let you increase the power above normal it just lets you dial it back. 



Features added
-Bigger Map for soccer (Soccer_BIG)
-Bigger Map for hockey (Hockey_BIG)
-Added option to change lobby/game size
-New Volleyball Gamemode (only 1v1 tested)
-New game mechanic adjust and control gun power
-New achievements

Bugs Fixed
-Fixed achievements I broke last update (Host a game + both Bert achievements)

Shout out to VEXIKKU on deviantart for the Chungus image I used
